analysis_unit: six mirrored blocks on one Mac; no physical-host replication

reference.label: actual published v0.5.0-beta.10
reference.alias_note: Original and incumbent are the same binary and same calls, not independent comparisons.

statistics.endpoint: NATIVE_SECONDS: complete native estimation call from the retained transport harness
statistics.block: Geometric mean of two calls per arm, then candidate/reference ratio. Excess = candidate - reference - max(0.05*reference,0.001 seconds).
statistics.interval: Exact one-sided binomial median bounds at alpha0.025; n6 gives lower=min and upper=max of six block excesses. Pass upper<=0; regression lower>0; otherwise inconclusive.
statistics.limits: Conditional on independent block scores with a common median; no simultaneous interval claim. Adjacent blocks on one desktop are not independent physical hosts.
statistics.call_medians: Arithmetic median of the12 measured calls per arm, excludes both warmups. Ratios of these medians differ from median block ratios.
statistics.diagnostics: runtime_input/native/total are retained RRUNTIME fields. Setup/solve are RSOLVER absorption and residual-absorption row columns8/9 (zero based); sums are descriptive, not exhaustive disjoint phase totals or causal attribution.
statistics.rates: rows_per_full_call_second=case rows divided by the full-call median; descriptive reciprocal, not another qualification endpoint.

science.fixed_worker_scope: Exact maintained scientific fingerprint at fixed worker count; timing excluded. Retained independent-reference output checks and cross-worker numerical/discrete checks passed in the maintained report.

observer.policy: Exact predeclared process identities only; no ancestry exemption. Bound Claude activity and ordinary desktop activity retained as noise. No exclusions or retries occurred.
observer.limits: Sampled process observation cannot prove absence of interference. Mac is a focused check; Linux remains primary. No causal adjustment or timing exclusion for background activity.

provenance.retention: All1508 timing rows are preserved below. Original raw results remain retained during the unfinished task. Individual timed native dumps were already reduced by the maintained harness to timing/scientific fingerprints; retained warmup snapshots and log hashes are preserved. No unfavorable observation was dropped by this audit.

block_minus_one: warmup; excluded from qualification statistics; retained in call order
